collection.title: Skoda Superb Saloon 2001 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Superb Saloon 2001 to 2004 model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the side Pin arm attachment.
